HOSTING_PROVENANCE_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the provenance dimension: hosting.provenance.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

hostProvenanceDiffers.doc: unknown: the figures were measured on a host other than the one the console runs on, so no verdict is carried over from them

text.en: The host that measured this plugin differs from the one running it now. Measure it again on this host, or accept the difference.

sweepControlDidNotFire.doc: unknown: the sweep's positive control did not fire, so nothing the sweep measured counts

text.en: The sweep’s control plugin did not fire during the measurement. Check the control plugin and measure again.
